column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2324's postgresOnlyTables regression test needs a REAL MySQL, same reasoning as TestCheckDBCountsTheTenantsDatabaseOnMySQL's own line (scripts/skip-ledger.tsv) beside it -- the defect it guards (runCheckDB reporting a PostgreSQL-only table MISSING on a genuinely healthy MySQL deployment) only reproduces against the real shipped migrations (testutil.SetupMySQLFullSchema), not a scripted mock driver. This job supplies no MySQL, so testutil.TestDB skips once. Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL go test ./cmd/cleatctl/ -run TestCheckDBDoesNotReportAPostgresOnlyTableMissingOnMySQL -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly 1.
